description: The DataServices class provides a collection of static service methods for handling content data resources, including creation, updating, rendering, and file management. It interacts with the OF Biz entity model, performs file I/O operations, and manages content stored in various formats.

classes.name: DataServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing content data resources, including creation, updates, rendering, and file operations within the OF Biz framework.

methods.name: clearAssociatedRenderCache
methods.description: Clears the cache associated with a specific data resource.

methods.name: createDataResourceAndText
methods.description: Creates a DataResource and associated ElectronicText if specified, handling both creation processes.

methods.name: createDataResource
methods.description: Wrapper to create a new DataResource with permission enforcement.

methods.name: createDataResourceMethod
methods.description: Core method to create a DataResource, handling the entity creation and default status assignment.

methods.name: createElectronicText
methods.description: Wrapper to create ElectronicText linked to a DataResource, with permission enforcement.

methods.name: createElectronicTextMethod
methods.description: Creates ElectronicText entity for a given data resource.

methods.name: createFile
methods.description: Wrapper for creating a file with permission enforcement.

methods.name: createFileNoPerm
methods.description: Creates a file without permission checks, validating filename and content before writing.

methods.name: createFileMethod
methods.description: Handles the actual file creation, writing text or binary data, and performing security validation.

methods.name: updateDataResourceAndText
methods.description: Updates DataResource and associated ElectronicText if applicable.

methods.name: updateDataResource
methods.description: Wrapper to update a DataResource with permission enforcement.

methods.name: updateDataResourceMethod
methods.description: Performs update on DataResource entity fields.

methods.name: updateElectronicText
methods.description: Wrapper to update ElectronicText content with permission enforcement.

methods.name: updateElectronicTextMethod
methods.description: Creates or updates ElectronicText associated with a DataResource.

methods.name: updateFile
methods.description: Wrapper to update a file with permission enforcement.

methods.name: updateFileMethod
methods.description: Handles updating a physical file's content, supporting text and binary data.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Wrapper to update an image resource with permission enforcement.

methods.name: updateImageMethod
methods.description: Updates image data for a resource.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Wrapper to create an image resource with permission enforcement.

methods.name: createImageMethod
methods.description: Creates a new image resource entity.

methods.name: createBinaryFile
methods.description: Wrapper to create a binary file resource with permission enforcement.

methods.name: createBinaryFileMethod
methods.description: Writes binary data to a specified content file.

methods.name: updateBinaryFile
methods.description: Wrapper to update a binary file resource with permission enforcement.

methods.name: updateBinaryFileMethod
methods.description: Updates binary content in a file for a data resource.

methods.name: renderDataResourceAsText
methods.description: Renders a data resource as text output using the dispatcher and template context.
